evidence: Updates src/net_processing.cpp with weight budgeting during P2P deserialization to reject oversized payloads early.
rationale: Protects node message processing from peer-induced memory exhaustion by tracking weight budgets and dropping malformed transactions or blocks before allocation. The PR description notes that deserialization for P2P streams now decrements a weight budget to reject payloads exceeding block limits and drops zero-input/output transactions immediately.
